Photo

Its lower edge sits at 399 of 470 — leaving 71 below it.

Sets the card, slips and envelope lining to the photo's own background colour, so a shrunken photo leaves no visible edge.

Fit inside plus Blend backdrop lets you shrink the picture within a fixed frame — the space around it fills with the picture's own background colour, so there's no visible edge.

Use a background-removed PNG — the same kind you used on the gift bag. Drag it anywhere on the card.

Images & florals

Six slots for anything you drop on — florals, or a photo of the two of you. Choose which panel it sits on, then drag it into place. Circle or Rounded with a gold ring turns a photo into an inset portrait.

Accent colour — for *marked* words

Wrap any words in *asterisks* to give them the accent colour — *ATTIRE:* Regal African Elegance puts the label in gold and leaves the rest in ink.

Equal line widths stretches the letter spacing of every line until all lines measure exactly the block width — that flush rectangular look. Drag any block on the card to place it. Eight slots, each independent.
